title: Two observations still depend on the physical intervention premise
statement: A failed.430ohm series path plus10.1744186S closed shunt and zero open shunt reproduces the healthy Gclosed12.5S/Gopen0 pair. A small-gamma certificate would falsely pass because its premise is violated, not because its conditional algebra fails. Independent B motion must preserve A loading and bound contamination movement/frame tilt; extra contacts, repeated linear-port readings or force commands alone do not do so. This is not an all-sensor impossibility.

assumptions: The certificate assumes invariant or independently bounded shunt conductance during B opening. Motion of contamination, A-load/frame changes or unverified conductor separation can violate it. Counterexamples concern the specified linear ports, not every sensor. Full paired-contact qualification, tooling, wear, service recovery and production advantage remain open.
